<script id="haw-date-picker-logic">
function hawKemeticFromGregorian(year, month, day, rules) {
  const diff = Math.trunc((Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day) - Date.UTC(...[rules.epoch[0], rules.epoch[1] - 1, rules.epoch[2]])) / 86400000);
  const cycle = rules.cycle, cycleSum = cycle.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  function result(kYear, dayOfYear) {
    return {kYear, kMonth:dayOfYear < 360 ? Math.floor(dayOfYear / 30) + 1 : 13,
      kDay:dayOfYear < 360 ? dayOfYear % 30 + 1 : dayOfYear - 360 + 1};
  }
  if (diff >= 0) {
    const cycles = Math.floor(diff / cycleSum);
    let kYear = 1 + cycles * 4, rem = diff - cycles * cycleSum, index = 0;
    while (rem >= cycle[index]) { rem -= cycle[index]; kYear++; index = (index + 1) & 3; }
    return result(kYear, rem);
  }
  let rem = (-diff - 1) % cycleSum;
  const reverse = [...cycle].reverse();
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    if (rem < reverse[i]) return result(0 - i, reverse[i] - 1 - rem);
    rem -= reverse[i];
  }
  return {kYear:-3, kMonth:13, kDay:1};
}

function createHawDatePicker({rules, months, onChange}) {
  const byId = name => document.getElementById('year-date-' + name);
  const dayMs = 86400000, rowHeight = rules.rowHeight;
  const now = new Date(), firstYear = now.getFullYear() - rules.yearRadius, lastYear = now.getFullYear() + rules.yearRadius;
  const utcDay = (year, month, day) => Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day) / dayMs;
  const minimum = utcDay(firstYear, 1, 1), maximum = utcDay(lastYear, 12, 31);
  const daysInMonth = (year, month) => new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate();
  const views = Object.fromEntries(['month', 'day', 'year'].map(field => [field, {element:byId(field), options:[], timer:null, index:0}]));
  let selected = utcDay(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth() + 1, now.getDate());
  function civil() {
    const d = new Date(selected * dayMs);
    return {year:d.getUTCFullYear(), month:d.getUTCMonth() + 1, day:d.getUTCDate()};
  }
  function kemetic() { const d = civil(); return hawKemeticFromGregorian(d.year, d.month, d.day, rules); }
  function yearStart() { const k = kemetic(); return selected - ((k.kMonth - 1) * 30 + k.kDay - 1); }
  function canSelectPosition(position) { const target = yearStart() + position * 10; return target >= minimum && target <= maximum; }
  function render(announce) {
    const d = civil(), k = kemetic();
    const values = {month:rules.gregorianMonths, day:Array.from({length:daysInMonth(d.year,d.month)}, (_, i) => String(i + 1)), year:Array.from({length:lastYear - firstYear + 1}, (_, i) => String(firstYear + i))};
    const indexes = {month:d.month - 1, day:d.day - 1, year:d.year - firstYear};
    for (const [field, view] of Object.entries(views)) {
      clearTimeout(view.timer);
      if (view.options.length !== values[field].length) {
        view.options = values[field].map((value, index) => {
          const option = document.createElement('div'); option.className = 'year-date-option';
          option.id = 'year-date-' + field + '-option-' + index; option.dataset.dateIndex = String(index);
          option.setAttribute('role', 'option'); option.textContent = value; return option;
        });
        view.element.replaceChildren(...view.options);
      }
      view.index = indexes[field];
      view.options.forEach((option, index) => option.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(index === view.index)));
      view.element.removeAttribute('data-static');
      view.element.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant', view.options[view.index].id);
      view.element.scrollTop = view.index * rowHeight;
    }
    const gregorian = rules.gregorianMonths[d.month - 1] + ' ' + d.day + ', ' + d.year;
    byId('gregorian').textContent = gregorian;
    if (announce) byId('announcement').textContent = gregorian + ' is ' + months[k.kMonth - 1].name + ' ' + k.kDay + '.';
    onChange(k, announce);
  }
  function selectDay(next, announce = true) { selected = Math.max(minimum, Math.min(maximum, next)); render(announce); }
  function choose(field, index) {
    const view = views[field];
    index = Math.max(0, Math.min(view.options.length - 1, index));
    if (index === view.index) return;
    const d = civil();
    if (field === 'month') d.month = index + 1;
    if (field === 'day') d.day = index + 1;
    if (field === 'year') d.year = firstYear + index;
    d.day = Math.min(d.day, daysInMonth(d.year, d.month));
    selectDay(utcDay(d.year, d.month, d.day));
  }
  for (const [field, view] of Object.entries(views)) {
    view.element.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      clearTimeout(view.timer);
      view.timer = setTimeout(() => choose(field, Math.round(view.element.scrollTop / rowHeight)), 90);
    }, {passive:true});
    view.element.addEventListener('click', event => {
      const option = event.target.closest('[data-date-index]');
      if (option) { view.element.focus({preventScroll:true}); choose(field, Number(option.dataset.dateIndex)); }
    });
    view.element.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
      const changes = {ArrowDown:1, ArrowUp:-1, PageDown:10, PageUp:-10};
      if (!(event.key in changes) && event.key !== 'Home' && event.key !== 'End') return;
      event.preventDefault();
      choose(field, event.key === 'Home' ? 0 : event.key === 'End' ? view.options.length - 1 : view.index + changes[event.key]);
    });
  }
  function today(announce = true) { const d = new Date(); selectDay(utcDay(d.getFullYear(), d.getMonth() + 1, d.getDate()), announce); }
  byId('today').addEventListener('click', () => today());
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => Object.values(views).forEach(view => clearTimeout(view.timer)));
  return {today, canSelectPosition, selectPosition(position) { if (canSelectPosition(position)) selectDay(yearStart() + position * 10); }};
}
</script>

<script id="haw-calendar-controller">
(() => {
  'use strict';
  const section = document.getElementById('explore-the-year');
  const data = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('haw-calendar-data').textContent);
  const byId = name => document.getElementById('year-' + name);
  const monthStars = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-year-month]')];
  const decanStars = [...section.querySelectorAll('[data-year-decan]')];
  const seasons = {akhet:'Akhet · Inundation', peret:'Peret · Emergence', shemu:'Shemu · Harvest', transition:'Days upon the Year'};
  let position = 0, generation = 0, active = null, datePicker;
  const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
  function text(id, value) { byId(id).textContent = value; }
  function prose(id, paragraphs) {
    byId(id).replaceChildren(...paragraphs.map(value => {
      const p = document.createElement('p'); p.textContent = value; return p;
    }));
  }
  function speechLabel(button, name, playing) {
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(playing));
    button.setAttribute('aria-label', (playing ? 'Stop pronunciation: ' : 'Play pronunciation: ') + name);
    button.title = playing ? 'Stop' : 'Play pronunciation';
  }
  function stopAudio() {
    ++generation;
    if (!active) return;
    const old = active; active = null;
    old.audio.pause(); old.audio.removeAttribute('src'); old.audio.load(); old.audio.remove();
    speechLabel(old.button, old.name, false);
  }
  async function speak(kind) {
    const button = byId(kind + '-speech');
    if (active?.button === button) { stopAudio(); return; }
    stopAudio();
    const item = kind === 'month' ? data.months[Math.floor(position / 3)] : data.decans[position];
    if (!item) return;
    byId('audio-status').hidden = true;
    document.querySelectorAll('video').forEach(video => video.pause());
    const token = generation, audio = document.createElement('audio');
    audio.id = 'year-pronunciation-audio'; audio.preload = 'none'; audio.hidden = true; audio.src = item.audio;
    section.append(audio); active = {audio, button, name:item.name};
    speechLabel(button, item.name, true);
    function failed() {
      if (token !== generation) return;
      stopAudio();
      const status = byId('audio-status');
      status.textContent = 'This pronunciation could not play. Please try again.'; status.hidden = false;
    }
    audio.addEventListener('ended', () => { if (token === generation) stopAudio(); });
    audio.addEventListener('error', failed);
    try { await audio.play(); } catch { failed(); }
  }
  function render(announce = true) {
    stopAudio(); byId('audio-status').hidden = true;
    const month = data.months[Math.floor(position / 3)], decan = data.decans[position];
    section.dataset.season = month.season;
    const [seasonName, seasonMeaning = 'Between years'] = seasons[month.season].split(' · ');
    text('season-name', seasonName); text('season-meaning', seasonMeaning);
    monthStars.forEach(button => {
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(Number(button.dataset.yearMonth) === month.id - 1));
      button.disabled = !datePicker.canSelectPosition(Number(button.dataset.yearMonth) * 3);
    });
    decanStars.forEach(button => {
      const offset = Number(button.dataset.yearDecan), item = data.decans[Math.floor(position / 3) * 3 + offset];
      button.disabled = !item || !datePicker.canSelectPosition(Math.floor(position / 3) * 3 + offset);
      button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(item?.id === decan?.id && !!decan));
      button.setAttribute('aria-label', item ? 'Explore ' + item.name + ', decan ' + item.id : 'Outside the 36 decans');
      text('choice-number-' + offset, item ? pad(item.id) : '—');
    });
    text('month-position', month.id === 13 ? 'After the twelve months' : 'Month ' + pad(month.id) + ' of 12');
    text('month-season', seasons[month.season]); text('month-name', month.name);
    text('month-transliteration', month.transliteration);
    text('month-theme', month.theme.split(' · ').slice(1).join(' · '));
    prose('month-prose', month.paragraphs); speechLabel(byId('month-speech'), month.name, false);
    byId('month-previous').disabled = month.id === 1 || !datePicker.canSelectPosition((month.id - 2) * 3);
    byId('month-next').disabled = !datePicker.canSelectPosition(month.id === 13 ? 0 : month.id * 3);
    byId('month-next').firstChild.textContent = month.id === 13 ? 'Begin again ' : month.id === 12 ? 'Days upon the Year ' : 'Next month ';
    section.querySelectorAll('[data-season]').forEach(el => el.toggleAttribute('data-active', el.dataset.season === month.season));
    byId('decan-detail').hidden = !decan; byId('threshold').hidden = !!decan;
    byId('decan-detail').parentElement.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', decan ? 'year-decan-name' : 'year-threshold-name');
    text('decan-position', decan ? 'Decan ' + pad(decan.id) + ' of 36' : 'Outside the 36 decans');
    text('decan-days', decan ? 'Days ' + ((position % 3) * 10 + 1) + '–' + ((position % 3 + 1) * 10) : 'Heriu Renpet');
    if (decan) {
      text('decan-name', decan.name); text('decan-meaning', decan.meaning); text('decan-theme', decan.theme);
      text('decan-glimpse', decan.paragraphs[0].match(/^.*?[.!?](?:\s|$)/)?.[0].trim() || decan.paragraphs[0]);
      prose('decan-prose', decan.paragraphs); speechLabel(byId('decan-speech'), decan.name, false);
    }
    byId('decan-previous').disabled = position === 0 || !datePicker.canSelectPosition(position - 1);
    byId('decan-next').disabled = !datePicker.canSelectPosition(position === 36 ? 0 : position + 1);
    byId('decan-next').firstChild.textContent = !decan ? 'Begin again ' : position === 35 ? 'Days upon the Year ' : 'Next decan ';
    if (announce) text('announcement', month.name + (decan ? '. Decan ' + decan.id + ' of 36: ' + decan.name + ', ' + decan.meaning + '.' : '. Days upon the Year, outside the 36 decans.'));
  }
  function goTo(next) { datePicker.selectPosition(Math.max(0, Math.min(36, next))); }
  function moveMonth(direction) {
    const month = Math.floor(position / 3);
    goTo(direction > 0 && month === 12 ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min(12, month + direction)) * 3);
  }
  function moveDecan(direction) {
    goTo(direction > 0 && position === 36 ? 0 : position + direction);
  }
  monthStars.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(Number(button.dataset.yearMonth) * 3)));
  decanStars.forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(Math.floor(position / 3) * 3 + Number(button.dataset.yearDecan))));
  byId('month-previous').addEventListener('click', () => moveMonth(-1));
  byId('month-next').addEventListener('click', () => moveMonth(1));
  byId('decan-previous').addEventListener('click', () => moveDecan(-1));
  byId('decan-next').addEventListener('click', () => moveDecan(1));
  byId('month-speech').addEventListener('click', () => speak('month'));
  byId('decan-speech').addEventListener('click', () => speak('decan'));
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopAudio);
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', () => { if (location.hash === '#contact') stopAudio(); });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) stopAudio(); });
  document.addEventListener('play', event => { if (event.target.tagName === 'VIDEO') stopAudio(); }, true);
  document.addEventListener('click', event => { if (event.target.closest('[data-preview]')) stopAudio(); });
  if (typeof IntersectionObserver !== 'undefined') new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
    if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) stopAudio();
  }).observe(section);
  datePicker = createHawDatePicker({rules:data.dateConversion, months:data.months, onChange:(k, announce) => {
    position = k.kMonth === 13 ? 36 : (k.kMonth - 1) * 3 + Math.floor((k.kDay - 1) / 10);
    render(announce);
  }});
  datePicker.today(false);
})();
</script>

Month 01 of 12Akhet · Inundation

AkhetInundation

Twelve months. Choose a star to wander.

Thoth

Ḏḥwty

Finding orientation when familiar ground disappears

Discover this month’s story

Water covers the land. Roads vanish. Field boundaries soften into the flood until almost nothing that once felt solid can be trusted by the eye alone. Thoth meets the year here because the first need is orientation: look before acting, gather what can still be observed, and allow a pattern to form before deciding what it means.

This is more than patience. A mistaken starting point carries its error into every correction that follows. Maat begins by making uncertainty legible—knowing where you stand, what remains true, and what deserves attention before labor begins. The work of this month is not to force clarity from the flood, but to measure carefully enough that right action will have somewhere firm to begin.

Go a little deeper

The flood has erased familiar boundaries. The first task is not action but bearing. The foremost stars matter because they give the eye somewhere to begin. Once one point is known, the rest of the sky can be read in relation to it.

Maat begins the same way. Before right action comes right orientation: know where you stand, what surrounds you, and which direction remains true when the usual landmarks disappear. A misplaced beginning carries its error forward. Before correcting anything, make sure you are looking from the right point.

and the next.
